content.text: In Zimbabwe, digital creators face a harsh reality: platforms like Stripe and PayPal are restricted, crippling their ability to sell online. This isn't just an inconvenience - it's an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-what-actually-how-6|Selling Design]]-beats-online-crypto-payments-2|infrastructure]] problem that demands a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-4|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] solution. With the right tools, you can build a crypto store that bypasses these limitations, giving you the freedom to sell your digital products to a global audience.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to a successful crypto store lies in its underlying infrastructure. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, you can host your store without relying on restrictive platforms. Combine this with a robust payment pipeline, and you've got a recipe for success. This infrastructure is designed to be autonomous, giving you full control over your store and its operations. You're not just building a store - you're building a sovereign commerce ecosystem.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start building your crypto store, you need to gather a few essential components. First, you'll need a digital product to sell - this could be an ebook, a course, or any other type of digital goods. Next, you'll need a way to host your store, which is where Cloudflare Pages comes in. Finally, you'll need a payment processor that can handle cryptocurrency transactions, such as NOWPayments. With these pieces in place, you're ready to start building.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in building your crypto store. You'll need to configure your payment processor to work with your store, which involves setting up webhooks and API keys. You'll also need to configure your delivery pipeline, which will handle the distribution of your digital products to customers. This may involve setting up a digital rights management system or a simple download link. Either way, the goal is to make the process as seamless as possible for your customers.
Build a crypto store that bypasses restrictive platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live with your store. This involves deploying your store to Cloudflare Pages and configuring any necessary DNS settings. Once your store is live, you can start processing transactions. The first transaction is always the most nerve-wracking, but with a solid infrastructure in place, you can trust that everything will work as expected. From here, it's just a matter of marketing your store and attracting customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. This may involve upgrading your Cloudflare Pages plan or adding more nodes to your payment pipeline. The key is to stay ahead of the curve, anticipating growth and planning accordingly. With a solid infrastructure in place, you'll be able to handle increased traffic and sales without breaking a sweat. This is where the true power of sovereign commerce infrastructure comes into play - you're not just building a store, you're building a scalable ecosystem.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Take control of your digital commerce infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a hassle-free way to build a crypto store, consider the Edge Commerce Stack. This product includes a fully deployed store on Cloudflare Pages, complete with a payment pipeline and delivery system. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can focus on what matters most - creating and selling your digital products.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store, follow these steps: set up your Cloudflare Pages account, configure your payment processor, deploy your store, configure your delivery pipeline, test your store, and go live. With these steps complete, you'll have a fully functional crypto store that can handle transactions and deliver digital products to customers. From here, it's just a matter of marketing and growth.
